value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: Clean Power Alliance's own homepage states it serves '38 communities across Los Angeles and Ventura counties' and names each one individually via its site's community directory; La Verne is not among the named communities. No other Los Angeles County CCA serving La Verne was found, so SCE is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

county.notes: La Verne is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of La Verne Building Department

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes La Verne/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: SolarAPP+ approval and approval number (linked back to the City Permit Portal application)

required_documents.notes: The page references a separate 'Solar Guidelines for Residential Photovoltaic Power Systems' handout for full submittal detail, not independently fetched this session.

value: Access the City Permit Portal and select 'Schedule My Solar Permit Inspections'
Enter the SolarAPP+ approval number to link permits
Available Monday-Thursday (closed Fridays); online scheduling or call 909-596-8706

other_conditions: Limited to roof-mounted, retrofit photovoltaic systems
Systems not eligible for SolarAPP+ must contact the Building Department directly

eligibility_constraints.notes: The 'under 10 KW-DC' streamlining threshold was described in search-engine synthesis of the city's SolarAPP+ implementation but not independently confirmed via the directly-fetched page content, so recorded with reduced confidence.

permit_fees.notes: The page states 'a processing fee will be charged by SolarAPP+ for each application submitted' but gives no dollar amount.
